title: Tour to Alhambra and Nasrid Palaces
text: Anna was our tour guide.  She is a true professional and described everything in a beautiful manner.  She not only talked about the history and construction but also did a great job in allowing us the experience the history from the point of view of those who built and occupied the palace in its glory days.  We wish all our tour guides can be that awesome.
author: Shazia_S
